title: Welcome, Mailchimp
summary: Whalesync now syncs Mailchimp, in beta on the Starter plan. Keep an audience in two-way sync with Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, or a database.
body_markdown:
Mailchimp is where a lot of small businesses and creators keep their mailing list. Our[Mailchimp connector](https://www.whalesync.com/connector/mailchimp) is out today in beta, and it’s on the Starter plan, our lowest paid tier.


Connect a Mailchimp account, pick an audience, and sync it with Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, a database, or any of the other apps we support.


## **Keep your audience in sync**


Contacts sync both ways, with their merge fields, groups, tags, VIP status, and GDPR consent. Add someone to your list in Airtable and they show up in Mailchimp. Update a contact in Mailchimp and the change comes back.


## **Report on campaigns, segments, and surveys**


Campaign results come across with their opens, clicks, and rates. Saved segments come with their members, and survey responses come too. These are read-only, ready to chart in a spreadsheet or query in a database.


## **Safe by design**


Whalesync never sends an email. A new contact is stored as transactional unless you sync a subscribed status, and deleting a record archives the contact instead of deleting it for good.


## **Getting started**


Our[Mailchimp connector docs](https://docs.whalesync.com/connectors/mailchimp) cover every field and how it behaves. The connector is in beta, so if it’s missing something you need,[reach out](https://docs.whalesync.com/resources/support) and tell us.
